metadata.title: Developing the Teacher mentoring self-efficacy scale (TMSES) using the Delphi method and exploratory factor analysis

extraction.outcome_summary: The study developed the Teacher Mentoring Self-Efficacy Scale (TMSES) through a two-phase design combining a UK Delphi panel and survey validation. The Delphi phase generated and refined 44 mentoring competencies, and the EFA on 239 complete responses reduced these to a 16-item, two-factor structure labeled Pedagogical Practices and Professional Relationships. The final scale showed strong internal consistency (alpha = 0.94 overall) and moderate-to-strong correlations with selected teacher self-efficacy and engagement items, supporting convergent and divergent validity. The analysis was exploratory rather than predictive, and the authors noted that confirmatory factor analysis in a new sample would be needed next.
